name: se
description: Shape ideas into agent-ready Feature Specs, maintain durable project knowledge, coordinate validated implementation delivery, and audit active sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Maintain project knowledge, shape Features, and coordinate reviewed delivery.
interface.longDescription: SE bundles six project-lifecycle skills: Learn maintains durable repository knowledge and ADRs; Improve Codebase Architecture finds and pressure-tests refactors; Idea captures proposals; Feature converges Feature Specs and agent-ready implementation issues; Implement creates one visible Sol/medium root controller for validated, reviewed delivery workers; and Audit monitors active SE sessions read-only. SE owns lifecycle semantics and orchestration; G owns GitHub transport and verification.
defaultPrompt: Use $se:learn to maintain durable project knowledge and ADRs.
Use $se:improve-codebase-architecture to find and pressure-test architecture improvements.
Use $se:feature to turn an Idea into an agent-ready Feature Spec bundle.
Audit active Codex tasks using SE skills and prioritize feedback, bugs, and improvements.
